synopsis_excerpt: The Value-Added Producer Grant (VAPG) program supports independent agricultural producers and producer groups in developing new products from raw commodities, expanding marketing opportunities, and increasing producer income. Awards are made in two categories: planning grants (up to $50,000) for feasibility studies and business plans, and working capital grants (up to $250,000) for operating activities directly related to processing, marketing, and distribution. Applicants must demonstrate a 1:1 match (cash or in-kind) and project performance period not exceeding three years.
